def choose_move(observation):
    agent = observation.get('agent', {})
    position = agent.get('position', (0, 0))
    resources = observation.get('resources', [])
    enemies = observation.get('enemies', [])
    territory = observation.get('territory', {})
    border = territory.get('border', [])

    def closest_target(targets):
        if not targets:
            return None
        return min(targets, key=lambda t: abs(t[0] - position[0]) + abs(t[1] - position[1]))

    # Collect potential targets based on environment
    resource_targets = resources
    enemy_targets = enemies
    territory_targets = border

    # Prioritize resource collection, then pursuit_evasion, then territory control
    target = closest_target(resource_targets) or closest_target(enemy_targets) or closest_target(territory_targets)

    if target:
        dx = target[0] - position[0]
        dy = target[1] - position[1]
        # Normalize to move at most one step in each direction
        dx = (dx > 0) - (dx < 0)
        dy = (dy > 0) - (dy < 0)
        return [dx, dy]
    else:
        # Default fallback move
        return [0, 0]
